paragraphs: Tavot Rishba: a bird-catcher, according to Rashi in Shabbat. Some explain it as head of a paternal house. He transmitted teachings in Shmuel’s name in Shabbat 146b and at the start of 17b. In the latter passage the name is Tavi. “From when do we say ‘and give dew and rain’?” Shmuel said: from when they bring wood into Tavot Rishba's house—Taanit 10a.
